verdict.rationale: Alacritty is a terminal emulator, and some terminals ship AI features that act as MCP clients, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only terminal features: vi mode, search, hints, multi-window, TOML config and IPC via `alacritty msg`. Nothing shows an MCP client, an AI agent, or any way to connect MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
